Package com.blukii.sdk.config.datatype

Klasse SmartPenValue

java.lang.Object
com.blukii.sdk.config.datatype.SmartPenValue
public class SmartPenValue extends Object
This class represents data type SmartPenValue as part of SmartPenValues Each SmartPenValue object contains payload bytes and a SmartPenValueType that defines what the bytes represent and the length of the data.

Important Note: Getter methods automatically parse the payload and return the expected values/objects

      public SmartPenValue(SmartPenValueType type, byte[] payload) throws Exception

    • getValue

      public AccelerometerValue getValue() throws Exception
      Gets the parsed IMU data of this object. Must only be called if the current object represents one of the IMU value types. SmartPenValueType.isIMUTypes()
      Gibt zurück:
      AccelerometerValue Representing one of: Acceleration, Angular Velocity, Magnetic Flux. Depending on the value type
      Löst aus:
      Exception - If the current object is not of IMU types.
